description: Source file for configuring and managing FLEXSPI clock and module initialization on NXP i.MX RT5xx series microcontrollers.

methods.name: flash_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the FLEXSPI module, disables clock and waits for idle state.

methods.name: flash_init
methods.description: Initializes the FLEXSPI module, configures DLL lock and resets.

methods.name: flexspi_setup_clock
methods.description: Configures the FLEXSPI clock source and divider, reinitializes module if needed.

methods.name: flexspi_clock_safe_config
methods.description: Sets FLEXSPI clock to a stable source to prevent XIP fetch issues during clock updates.
